data.bio: Philip Jr. comes from the complex Stevens family, where his grandmother Elena had 8 children with 3 different partners. This unique family structure has taught him the importance of family bonds regardless of biological relationships. Philip works as a social worker, helping families navigate complex situations similar to his own family background. He values all of his aunts, uncles, and cousins, recognizing that family is defined by love and connection rather than just genetics. Philip enjoys reading, playing basketball, and spending time with his extended family.

work_entries.title: Family Social Worker
work_entries.description: Help families navigate complex situations, provide support services, and connect families with resources. Specialized in blended and extended family dynamics.

education_entries.title: Master of Social Work
education_entries.description: Earned MSW with focus on family services and child welfare.

education_entries.title: Bachelor of Arts in Psychology
education_entries.description: Graduated with focus on psychology and social work.

data.bio: Elena was a strong and resilient woman who raised 8 children with 3 different partners, creating a large and diverse family. She worked hard to provide for all of her children and instilled in them the importance of family unity. Elena was known for her warmth, her cooking, and her ability to bring everyone together. She passed away several years ago, but her legacy lives on through her children and grandchildren.

Alfred Sr. was Elena's first partner and the father of her two oldest children. He worked as a factory worker and was known for his strong work ethic. Alfred Sr. passed away in 1995, but his memory lives on through his children and grandchildren.

work_entries.title: Factory Worker
work_entries.description: Worked in manufacturing, operated machinery, and maintained production lines.

data.bio: Philip's mother, the oldest daughter of Elena and Alfred Sr. She worked as a nurse and was a devoted mother to Philip. She passed away when Philip was young, but her memory lives on.

work_entries.title: Registered Nurse
work_entries.description: Provided patient care in various hospital departments.
